# Signal Fish .NET Client

> C# client SDK (`netstandard2.1`, Unity compatible) for the Signal Fish
> multiplayer signaling server: rooms, lobbies, reconnection, relay, and
> optional v3 negotiation over WebSocket.

- [AI Agent Guidelines](.llm/context.md): canonical agent context. All
  front-end pointer files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor rules,
  Copilot instructions) delegate to it.
- [Skills Index](.llm/skills/index.md): generated catalog of agent skills
  ([Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format, one `SKILL.md` per folder).
- [Protocol Quick Reference](.llm/references/protocol-quick-reference.md):
  endpoints, message tables, close codes, error codes, limits.
- [Improvement Log](.llm/improvement-log.md): dated retrospective entries
  staged by the mandatory reflect-improve loop; durable knowledge graduates
  into skills and references.
- Upstream server: https://github.com/Ambiguous-Interactive/signal-fish-server

## Optional

- [Automation scripts](scripts/): index generation, size/instruction linters,
  self-tests (`pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/tests/run-all.ps1`).
